description: Builds on the customer's own GitHub (provider github) for one builder app: enabled (this server has the AppForShare Builds GitHub app), installs (GitHub accounts and organizations with the app installed, id = install id), repo (the app's repository: name, branch, last push and commit, Actions and secrets pages, iOS signing: iosTeamId and ascConnectionId, null = the customer adds the App Store Connect key secrets in GitHub; iosAppStore = iOS builds are signed for the App Store, so they can go to TestFlight and App Store review through builder_release, else for testers with an install link; private = GitHub visibility), ascConnections (workspace App Store Connect connections that can provide the key), newRepoUrl (GitHub page to create an empty repository), secretNames. With install: also repos = the repositories that install can reach (id, name, usedBy = the builder app already on it). Read only. Every plan with an account; listing repositories needs the Admin role.

install.description: Install id from installs: also list its repositories

name: builder_github
title: Your GitHub builds of a builder app
